precision.description: Operation precision to be used on inference. Valid value is one of: [fp32, fp16, int8].

score_threshold.description: Detection score threshold for the whole-image yolox detector.

nms_threshold.description: NMS threshold for the whole-image yolox detector.

calibration_algorithm.description: Calibration algorithm to be used for quantization when precision==int8. Valid value is one of: [Entropy, (Legacy | Percentile), MinMax].

dla_core_id.description: If positive, the node assigns the inference task to the DLA core with this ID.

quantize_first_layer.description: If true, set the operating precision for the first (input) layer to fp16. Valid only when precision==int8.

quantize_last_layer.description: If true, set the operating precision for the last (output) layer to fp16. Valid only when precision==int8.

profile_per_layer.description: If true, enable the profiler function. May affect execution speed; recommended for development only.

clip_value.description: If positive, clip each layer's output between [0.0, clip_value]. Valid only when precision==int8 and used instead of a calibration-derived dynamic range.

calibration_image_list_path.description: Path to a file listing image paths used for int8 quantization calibration. Empty disables calibration.

gpu_id.description: CUDA device ID to run inference on.

max_vibration_pitch.description: Maximum error in pitch direction. If -5~+5, it will be 10.

max_vibration_yaw.description: Maximum error in yaw direction. If -5~+5, it will be 10.

max_vibration_height.description: Maximum error in height direction. If -5~+5, it will be 10.

max_vibration_width.description: Maximum error in width direction. If -5~+5, it will be 10.

max_vibration_depth.description: Maximum error in depth direction. If -5~+5, it will be 10.

max_detection_range.description: Maximum detection range in meters. Must be positive.

car_traffic_light_max_angle_range.description: Maximum angle range for detecting car traffic lights (degrees).

pedestrian_traffic_light_max_angle_range.description: Maximum angle range for detecting pedestrian traffic lights (degrees).

min_timestamp_offset.description: Minimum timestamp offset when searching for the corresponding map->camera tf sample.

max_timestamp_offset.description: Maximum timestamp offset when searching for the corresponding map->camera tf sample.

traffic_light_type.description: tier4_perception_msgs::msg::TrafficLight::CAR_TRAFFIC_LIGHT (0) or ::PEDESTRIAN_TRAFFIC_LIGHT (1). Selects which ROIs this classifier instance classifies.

precision.description: Operation precision to be used on inference. Valid value is one of: [fp32, fp16, int8].

mean.description: Per-channel mean used to normalize the classifier input image (RGB order).

std.description: Per-channel standard deviation used to normalize the classifier input image (RGB order).

over_exposure_threshold.description: ROI mean-intensity threshold above which the ROI is treated as over-exposed and classified as UNKNOWN.

under_exposure_threshold.description: ROI mean-intensity threshold below which the ROI is treated as under-exposed and classified as UNKNOWN.

build_only.description: Build the TensorRT engines for the whole-image detector and the classifiers and exit, without waiting for the vector map.
